name: Evals — Generative model (data_source.model)
summary: The model that *generates* completions to be evaluated in an eval run, specified via `data_source.model` on POST /v1/evals/{id}/runs.
description: OpenAI eval runs have two distinct `model` slots: the **judge** (grader) and the **generator** (data source). The existing `evaluations` card in this matrix tracks the judge model via `initialization_parameters.deployment_name`. This card covers the *other* slot — `data_source.model` — used when the eval run is configured with `type:"responses"` or `type:"completions"` to have the platform generate the completions to grade. BYOM behavior for this slot is not yet validated: it's a nested `model` field that must survive the same gateway forwarding as the judge, but on a different code path.
notes: Status-only. Note the OpenAI evals platform is scheduled to deprecate: read-only Oct 31 2026, shutdown Nov 30 2026. Foundry evaluations are a separate product but expose the same conceptual dual-model shape.
